sections.label: Book 17
sections.name: The completed fire altar; prayers to Agni and Indra

verses.sa: अश्मन्नूर्जं पर्वते शिश्रियाणामद्भ्य ओषधीभ्यो वनस्पतिभ्यो अधि सम्भृतं पयः। तां न इषमूर्जं धत्त मरुतः संरराणाः अश्मँस्ते क्षुन्मयि त ऊर्ग्यं द्विष्मस्तं ते शुगृच्छतु॥
verses.tr: aśmannūrjaṃ parvate śiśriyāṇāmadbhya oṣadhībhyo vanaspatibhyo adhi sambhṛtaṃ payaḥ tāṃ na iṣamūrjaṃ dhatta marutaḥ saṃrarāṇāḥ aśmaṃste kṣunmayi ta ūrgyaṃ dviṣmastaṃ te śugṛcchatu
verses.en: The food and strength contained in stone and mountain, drink g gathered from the plants and trees and waters, That food and strength, Maruts! I free-givers, grant us. In the stone is thy hunger. In me is ia thy food. Let thy pain reach the man mm we hate.

verses.sa: इमा मे अग्न इष्टका धेनवः सन्त्वेका च दश च दश च शतं च शतं च सहस्रं च सहस्रं चायुतं चायुतं च नियुतं च नियुतं च प्रयुतं चार्बुदं च न्यर्बुदं समुद्रश्च मध्यं चान्तश्च परार्धश्चैता मे अग्न इष्टका धेनवः सन्त्वमुत्रामुष्मिँल्लोके॥
verses.tr: imā me agna iṣṭakā dhenavaḥ santvekā ca daśa ca daśa ca śataṃ ca śataṃ ca sahasraṃ ca sahasraṃ cāyutaṃ cāyutaṃ ca niyutaṃ ca niyutaṃ ca prayutaṃ cārbudaṃ ca nyarbudaṃ samudraśca madhyaṃ cāntaśca parārdhaścaitā me agna iṣṭakā dhenavaḥ santvamutrāmuṣmiṃlloke
verses.en: O Agni, may these bricks be mine own milch kine: one, and ten, and ten tens, a hundred, and ten hundreds, a thousand, and ten thousand a myriad, and a hundred thousand, and a million, and a hundred millions, and an ocean middle and end, and a hundred thousand millions, and a billion. May these bricks be mine own milch-kine in yonder world and in this world.

verses.sa: ऋतव स्थ ऋतावृध ऋतुष्ठा स्थ ऋतावृधः। घृतश्च्युतो मधुश्च्युतो विराजो नाम कामदुघा अक्षीयमाणाः॥
verses.tr: ṛtava stha ṛtāvṛdha ṛtuṣṭhā stha ṛtāvṛdhaḥ ghṛtaścyuto madhuścyuto virājo nāma kāmadughā akṣīyamāṇāḥ
verses.en: Ye are the Seasons, strengthening Law, fixed in due season, strengthening Law, Called Splendid, dropping butter down and honey, yielders of every wish, imperishable.

verses.sa: समुद्रस्य त्वाऽवकयाग्ने परि व्ययामसि। पावको अस्मभ्यं शिवो भव॥
verses.tr: samudrasya tvā'vakayāgne pari vyayāmasi pāvako asmabhyaṃ śivo bhava
verses.en: With the lake*s mantling need we robe thee, Agni: to us be purifying and auspicious.

verses.sa: हिमस्य त्वा जरायुणाऽग्ने परि व्ययामसि। पावको अस्मभ्यं शिवो भव॥
verses.tr: himasya tvā jarāyuṇā'gne pari vyayāmasi pāvako asmabhyaṃ śivo bhava
verses.en: With cold's investing garb we gird thee, Agni: to us be purifying and auspicious.

verses.sa: उप ज्मन्नुप वेतसेऽव तर नदीष्वा। अग्ने पित्तमपामसि मण्डूकि ताभिरा गहि सेमं नो यज्ञं पावकवर्णं शिवं कृधि॥
verses.tr: upa jmannupa vetase'va tara nadīṣvā agne pittamapāmasi maṇḍūki tābhirā gahi semaṃ no yajñaṃ pāvakavarṇaṃ śivaṃ kṛdhi
verses.en: Descend upon the earth, the reed, the rivers: thou art the gall, O Agni, of the waters. With them come hither, female Frog, and render this sacrifice of ours bright-hued, successful.

verses.sa: अपामिदं न्ययनं समुद्रस्य निवेशनम्। अन्याँस्ते अस्मत्तपन्तु हेतयः पावको अस्मभ्यं शिवो भव॥
verses.tr: apāmidaṃ nyayanaṃ samudrasya niveśanam anyāṃste asmattapantu hetayaḥ pāvako asmabhyaṃ śivo bhava
verses.en: This is the place where waters meet; here is the gathering of the flood. Let thy shaft burn others than us: be thou cleanser, propitious unto us.

verses.sa: अग्ने पावक रोचिषा मन्द्रया देव जिह्वया। आ देवान् वक्षि यक्षि च॥
verses.tr: agne pāvaka rociṣā mandrayā deva jihvayā ā devān vakṣi yakṣi ca
verses.en: O Agni, purifier, God, with splendour and thy pleasant tongue. Bring hither, and adore, the Gods.

verses.sa: स नः पावक दीदिवोऽग्ने देवाँ२ इहा वह। उप यज्ञं हविश्च नः॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ pāvaka dīdivo'gne devāṃ2 ihā vaha upa yajñaṃ haviśca naḥ
verses.en: So, Agni, purifying, bright, bring hither to our sacrifice, To our oblation bring the Gods.

verses.sa: पावकया यश्चितयन्त्या कृपा क्षामन् रुरुच उषसो न भानुना। तूर्वन् न यामन्नेतशस्य नू रण आ यो घृणे न ततृषाणो अजरः॥
verses.tr: pāvakayā yaścitayantyā kṛpā kṣāman ruruca uṣaso na bhānunā tūrvan na yāmannetaśasya nū raṇa ā yo ghṛṇe na tatṛṣāṇo ajaraḥ
verses.en: He who with purifying, eye-attracting form hath shone upon the earth as with the light of Dawn; Who speeding on, as in the fleet steed's race, in' fight, cometh untouched by age, as one athirst in heat.

verses.sa: नमस्ते हरसे शोचिषे नमस्ते अस्त्वर्चिषे। अन्याँस्ते अस्मत्तपन्तु हेतयः पावको अस्मभ्यं शिवो भव॥
verses.tr: namaste harase śociṣe namaste astvarciṣe anyāṃste asmattapantu hetayaḥ pāvako asmabhyaṃ śivo bhava
verses.en: Obeisance to thy wrath, and glow! Obeisance to thy fiery flame! Let thy shot missiles burn others than us; be thou cleanser, propitious unto us.

verses.sa: नृषदे वेडप्सुषदे वेड् बर्हिषदे वेड् वनसदे वेड् स्वर्विदे वेट्॥
verses.tr: nṛṣade veḍapsuṣade veḍ barhiṣade veḍ vanasade veḍ svarvide veṭ
verses.en: To him who dwells in man, Hail! To him who dwells in waters, Hail! To him who dwells in sacred grass, Hail! To him who dwells in the wood, Hail! To him who finds the light, Hail! I

verses.sa: ये देवा देवानां यज्ञिया यज्ञियानां संवत्सरीणमुप भागमासते। अहुतादो हविषो यज्ञे अस्मिन्त्स्वयं पिबन्तु मधुनो घृतस्य॥
verses.tr: ye devā devānāṃ yajñiyā yajñiyānāṃ saṃvatsarīṇamupa bhāgamāsate ahutādo haviṣo yajñe asmintsvayaṃ pibantu madhuno ghṛtasya
verses.en: Worshipful Gods of Gods who merit worship, those who sit down beside their yearly portion, Let them who eat not sacrificial presents drink in this rite.of honey and of butter.

verses.sa: ये देवा देवेष्वधि देवत्वमायन् ये ब्रह्मणः पुर एतारो अस्य। येभ्यो न ऋते पवते धाम किञ्चन न ते दिवो न पृथिव्या अधि स्नुषु॥
verses.tr: ye devā deveṣvadhi devatvamāyan ye brahmaṇaḥ pura etāro asya yebhyo na ṛte pavate dhāma kiñcana na te divo na pṛthivyā adhi snuṣu
verses.en: Those Gods who have attained to Godhead over Gods, they who have led the way in this our holy work, Without whose aid no body whatsoever moves, not on heaven's heights are they, nor on the face of earth.

verses.sa: प्राणदा अपानदा व्यानदा वर्चोदा वरिवोदाः। अन्याँस्ते अस्मत्तपन्तु हेतयः पावको अस्मभ्यं शिवो भव॥
verses.tr: prāṇadā apānadā vyānadā varcodā varivodāḥ anyāṃste asmattapantu hetayaḥ pāvako asmabhyaṃ śivo bhava
verses.en: Giver of breath, of out-breath, breath diffusive, giver of lustre, giving room and freedom, Let thy shot missiles burn others than us: be thou cleanser, propitious unto us.

verses.sa: अग्निस्तिग्मेन शोचिषा यासद्विश्वं न्यत्रिणम्। अग्निर्नो वनते रयिम्॥
verses.tr: agnistigmena śociṣā yāsadviśvaṃ nyatriṇam agnirno vanate rayim
verses.en: May Agni with his sharpened blaze cast down each fierce devouring fiend. May Agni win us wealth by war.

verses.sa: य इमा विश्वा भुवनानि जुह्वदृषिर्होता न्यसीदत् पिता नः। स आशिषा द्रविणमिच्छमानः प्रथमच्छदवराँ२ आ विवेश॥
verses.tr: ya imā viśvā bhuvanāni juhvadṛṣirhotā nyasīdat pitā naḥ sa āśiṣā draviṇamicchamānaḥ prathamacchadavarāṃ2 ā viveśa
verses.en: He who sate down as Hotar priest, the Rishi, our Father offering up all things existent—He, seeking with his wish a great possession, came among men on earth as archetypal.

verses.sa: किंस्विदासीदधिष्ठानमारम्भणं कतमत्स्वित्कथाऽऽसीत्। यतो भूमिं जनयन् विश्वकर्मा वि द्यामौर्णोन्महिना विश्वचक्षाः॥
verses.tr: kiṃsvidāsīdadhiṣṭhānamārambhaṇaṃ katamatsvitkathā''sīt yato bhūmiṃ janayan viśvakarmā vi dyāmaurṇonmahinā viśvacakṣāḥ
verses.en: What was the place whereon he took his station? What was it that upheld him? What the manner, Whence Yisvakarman, seeing all, producing the earth, with mighty power disclosed I the heavens?

verses.sa: विश्वतश्चक्षुरुत विश्वतोमुखो विश्वतोबाहुरुत विश्वतस्पात्। सं बाहुभ्यां धमति सं पतत्रैर्द्यावाभूमी जनयन् देव एकः॥
verses.tr: viśvataścakṣuruta viśvatomukho viśvatobāhuruta viśvataspāt saṃ bāhubhyāṃ dhamati saṃ patatrairdyāvābhūmī janayan deva ekaḥ
verses.en: He who hath eyes on all side round ubout him, a mouth ott ail sides, arms and feet on all sidf^s, He the sole God, producing: earth and heaven, weldeth them with his arms as wings together.

verses.sa: किंस्विद्वनं क उ स वृक्ष आस यतो द्यावापृथिवी निष्टतक्षुः। मनीषिणो मनसा पृच्छतेदु तद्यदध्यतिष्ठद्भुवनानि धारयन्॥
verses.tr: kiṃsvidvanaṃ ka u sa vṛkṣa āsa yato dyāvāpṛthivī niṣṭatakṣuḥ manīṣiṇo manasā pṛcchatedu tadyadadhyatiṣṭhadbhuvanāni dhārayan
verses.en: What was the tree, what wood in sooth produced it, from which they fashioned out the earth and heaven? Ye thoughtful men, inquire within your spirit whereon he stood when he established all things.

verses.sa: या ते धामानि परमाणि याऽवमा या मध्यमा विश्वकर्मन्नुतेमा। शिक्षा सखिभ्यो हविषि स्वधावः स्वयं यजस्व तन्वं वृधानः॥
verses.tr: yā te dhāmāni paramāṇi yā'vamā yā madhyamā viśvakarmannutemā śikṣā sakhibhyo haviṣi svadhāvaḥ svayaṃ yajasva tanvaṃ vṛdhānaḥ
verses.en: Thine highest, lowest sacrificial natures, and these thy midmost here, O Visvakarman, Teach thou thy friends at sacrifice, O Blessed, and come thyself, exalted, to our worship.

verses.sa: विश्वकर्मन् हविषा वावृधानः स्वयं यजस्व पृथिवीमुत द्याम्। मुह्यन्त्वन्ये अभितः सपत्ना इहास्माकं मघवा सूरिरस्तु॥
verses.tr: viśvakarman haviṣā vāvṛdhānaḥ svayaṃ yajasva pṛthivīmuta dyām muhyantvanye abhitaḥ sapatnā ihāsmākaṃ maghavā sūrirastu
verses.en: Bring those, thyself exalted with oblation, O Viavakaitnau, Earth and Heaven to worship. Let enemies around us live in folly: here let us u have a rich and liberal patron.

verses.sa: वाचस्पतिं विश्वकर्माणमूतये मनोजुवं वाजे अद्या हुवेम। स नो विश्वानि हवनानि जोषद्विश्वशम्भूरवसे साधुकर्मा॥ विश्वकर्मन् हविषा वर्धनेन त्रातारमिन्द्रमकृणोरवध्यम्। तस्मै विशः समनमन्त पूर्वीरयमुग्रो विहव्यो यथाऽसत्॥
verses.tr: vācaspatiṃ viśvakarmāṇamūtaye manojuvaṃ vāje adyā huvema sa no viśvāni havanāni joṣadviśvaśambhūravase sādhukarmā viśvakarman haviṣā vardhanena trātāramindramakṛṇoravadhyam tasmai viśaḥ samanamanta pūrvīrayamugro vihavyo yathā'sat
verses.en: -VIII.

verses.sa: चक्षुषः पिता मनसा हि धीरो घृतमेने अजनन्नम्नमाने। यदेदन्ता अददृहन्त पूर्व आदिद् द्यावापृथिवी अप्रथेताम्॥
verses.tr: cakṣuṣaḥ pitā manasā hi dhīro ghṛtamene ajanannamnamāne yadedantā adadṛhanta pūrva ādid dyāvāpṛthivī aprathetām
verses.en: The Father of the eye, the Wise in spirit, created both these worlds submerged in fatness. when which the eastern ends were firmly fastened, the heavens and the earth were far f-r extended.

verses.sa: विश्वकर्मा विमना आद्विहाया धाता विधाता परमोत सन्दृक्। तेषामिष्टानि समिषा मदन्ति यत्रा सप्त ऋषीन् पर एकमाहुः॥
verses.tr: viśvakarmā vimanā ādvihāyā dhātā vidhātā paramota sandṛk teṣāmiṣṭāni samiṣā madanti yatrā sapta ṛṣīn para ekamāhuḥ
verses.en: Mighty in mind and power is Vi-vakannan, Maker, Disposer, and most lofty Presence, Their offerings 'joy in rich juice where they value One, only One beyond the Seven Bishis.

verses.sa: यो नः पिता जनिता यो विधाता धामानि वेद भुवनानि विश्वा। यो देवानां नामधा एक एव तं सम्प्रश्नं भुवना यन्त्यन्या॥
verses.tr: yo naḥ pitā janitā yo vidhātā dhāmāni veda bhuvanāni viśvā yo devānāṃ nāmadhā eka eva taṃ sampraśnaṃ bhuvanā yantyanyā
verses.en: Father who made us, he who, as Disposer, knoweth all races and all things existing, Even he alone, the Deities' name giver,—him other beings seek for information.

verses.sa: त आऽयजन्त द्रविणं समस्मा ऋषयः पूर्वे जरितारो न भूना। असूर्ते सूर्ते रजसि निषत्ते ये भूतानि समकृण्वन्निमानि॥
verses.tr: ta ā'yajanta draviṇaṃ samasmā ṛṣayaḥ pūrve jaritāro na bhūnā asūrte sūrte rajasi niṣatte ye bhūtāni samakṛṇvannimāni
verses.en: To him in sacrifice they offered treasures,—Bishis of old, in numerous troops, as singers, Who, in the distant, near, and lower region, made ready all these things that have existence.

verses.sa: परो दिवा पर एना पृथिव्या परो देवेभिरसुरैर्यदस्ति। कंस्विद् गर्भं प्रथमं दध्र आपो यत्र देवाः समपश्यन्त पूर्वे॥
verses.tr: paro divā para enā pṛthivyā paro devebhirasurairyadasti kaṃsvid garbhaṃ prathamaṃ dadhra āpo yatra devāḥ samapaśyanta pūrve
verses.en: That which is earlier than this earth and heaven, before the Asuras and (>Gods had being,—What was the germ primeval which the waters received where the first Gods beheld each other?

verses.sa: तमिद्गर्भं प्रथमं दध्र आपो यत्र देवाः समगच्छन्त विश्वे। अजस्य नाभावध्येकमर्पितं यस्मिन् विश्वानि भुवनानि तस्थुः॥
verses.tr: tamidgarbhaṃ prathamaṃ dadhra āpo yatra devāḥ samagacchanta viśve ajasya nābhāvadhyekamarpitaṃ yasmin viśvāni bhuvanāni tasthuḥ
verses.en: The waters, they received that germ primeval wherein the Gods were gathered all together. It rested set upon the Unborn's navel, that One wherein abide all things existing.

verses.sa: न तं विदाथ य इमा जजानान्यद्युष्माकमन्तरं बभूव। नीहारेण प्रावृता जल्प्या चासुतृप उक्थशासश्चरन्ति॥
verses.tr: na taṃ vidātha ya imā jajānānyadyuṣmākamantaraṃ babhūva nīhāreṇa prāvṛtā jalpyā cāsutṛpa ukthaśāsaścaranti
verses.en: Ye will not find him who produced these creatures: another thing hath risen up among you. Eiiwrapt in misty cloud, with lips that stammer, hymn chanters wander and are discontented.

verses.sa: विश्वकर्मा ह्यजनिष्ट देव आदिद्गन्धर्वो अभवद् द्वितीयः। तृतीयः पिता जनितौषधीनामपां गर्भं व्यदधात् पुरुत्रा॥
verses.tr: viśvakarmā hyajaniṣṭa deva ādidgandharvo abhavad dvitīyaḥ tṛtīyaḥ pitā janitauṣadhīnāmapāṃ garbhaṃ vyadadhāt purutrā
verses.en: First was the God engendered, Visvakarman: then the Gandharva sprang to life as second. Third in succession was the plants' begetter: be laid the water' germ in many places.

verses.sa: आशुः शिशानो वृषभो न भीमो घनाघनः क्षोभणश्चर्षणीनाम्। संक्रन्दनोऽनिमिष एकवीरः शतं सेना अजयत् साकमिन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: āśuḥ śiśāno vṛṣabho na bhīmo ghanāghanaḥ kṣobhaṇaścarṣaṇīnām saṃkrandano'nimiṣa ekavīraḥ śataṃ senā ajayat sākamindraḥ
verses.en: Swift, rapidly striking, like a bull who sharpens his horns, terrific, stirring up the people, With eyes that close not, bellowing. Sole Hero, Indra at once a hundred armies.

verses.sa: संक्रन्दनेनानिमिषेण जिष्णुना युत्कारेण दुश्च्यवनेन धृष्णुना। तदिन्द्रेण जयत तत्सहध्वं युधो नर इषुहस्तेन वृष्णा॥
verses.tr: saṃkrandanenānimiṣeṇa jiṣṇunā yutkāreṇa duścyavanena dhṛṣṇunā tadindreṇa jayata tatsahadhvaṃ yudho nara iṣuhastena vṛṣṇā
verses.en: With him loud-roaring, ever watchful, Victor, bold, hard to overthrow, Rouser of battle, Indra the Strong, whose hand bears arrows, conquer, ye warriors, now, now vanquish in the combat.

verses.sa: स इषुहस्तैः स निषङ्गिभिर्वशी संस्रष्टा स युध इन्द्रो गणेन। संसृष्टजित्सोमपा बाहुशर्ध्युग्रधन्वा प्रतिहिताभिरस्ता॥
verses.tr: sa iṣuhastaiḥ sa niṣaṅgibhirvaśī saṃsraṣṭā sa yudha indro gaṇena saṃsṛṣṭajitsomapā bāhuśardhyugradhanvā pratihitābhirastā
verses.en: He rules with those who carry shafts and quivers, Indra who with his band brings hosts together, Foe-conquering, strong ig of arm, the Soma-drinker, with mighty bow, shooting with well-laid arrows.

verses.sa: बृहस्पते परि दीया रथेन रक्षोहाऽमित्राँ२ अपबाधमानः। प्रभञ्जन्त्सेनाः प्रमृणो युधा जयन्नस्माकमेध्यविता रथानाम्॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspate pari dīyā rathena rakṣohā'mitrāṃ2 apabādhamānaḥ prabhañjantsenāḥ pramṛṇo yudhā jayannasmākamedhyavitā rathānām
verses.en: Brihaspati, fly with thy chariot hither, slayer of demons, driving off our foemen. Be thou protector of our cars, destroyer, victor in battle, breaker-up of armies.

verses.sa: बलविज्ञाय स्थविरः प्रवीरः सहस्वान् वाजी सहमान उग्रः। अभिवीरो अभिसत्वा सहोजा जैत्रमिन्द्र रथमा तिष्ठ गोवित्॥
verses.tr: balavijñāya sthaviraḥ pravīraḥ sahasvān vājī sahamāna ugraḥ abhivīro abhisatvā sahojā jaitramindra rathamā tiṣṭha govit
verses.en: Conspicuous by thy strength, firm, foremost fighter, mighty and fierce, victorious, all-subduing. The Son of Conquest, passing men and heroes, kine-winner, mount thy conquering car, O Indra.

verses.sa: गोत्रभिदं गोविदं वज्रबाहुं जयन्तमज्म प्रमृणन्तमोजसा। इमं सजाता अनु वीरयध्वमिन्द्रं सखायो अनु सं रभध्वम्॥
verses.tr: gotrabhidaṃ govidaṃ vajrabāhuṃ jayantamajma pramṛṇantamojasā imaṃ sajātā anu vīrayadhvamindraṃ sakhāyo anu saṃ rabhadhvam
verses.en: Cleaver of stalls, kine-winner, armed I with thunder, who quells ar. army and with might (destroys it,—Follow him, brothers! quit yours dves like heroes, and like this Indra show your zeal and courage.

verses.sa: अभि गोत्राणि सहसा गाहमानोऽदयो वीरः शतमन्युरिन्द्रः। दुश्च्यवनः पृतनाषाडयुध्योऽस्माकं सेना अवतु प्र युत्सु॥
verses.tr: abhi gotrāṇi sahasā gāhamāno'dayo vīraḥ śatamanyurindraḥ duścyavanaḥ pṛtanāṣāḍayudhyo'smākaṃ senā avatu pra yutsu
verses.en: Piercing the cow-stalls with surpassing vigour, Indra, the pitiless Hero, wild with anger, Victor in fight, unshaken and resistless,—may he protect our armies in our battles.

verses.sa: इन्द्र आसां नेता बृहस्पतिर्दक्षिणा यज्ञः पुर एतु सोमः। देवसेनानामभिभञ्जतीनां जयन्तीनां मरुतो यन्त्वग्रम्॥
verses.tr: indra āsāṃ netā bṛhaspatirdakṣiṇā yajñaḥ pura etu somaḥ devasenānāmabhibhañjatīnāṃ jayantīnāṃ maruto yantvagram
verses.en: Indra; guide these: Brihaspati precede them, the guerdon, and the sacrifice, and Soma; And let the banded Maruts march in forefront of heavenly hosts that conquer and demolish.

verses.sa: इन्द्रस्य वृष्णो वरुणस्य राज्ञ आदित्यानां मरुतां शर्ध उग्रम्। महामनसां भुवनच्यवानां घोषो देवानां जयतामुदस्थात्॥
verses.tr: indrasya vṛṣṇo varuṇasya rājña ādityānāṃ marutāṃ śardha ugram mahāmanasāṃ bhuvanacyavānāṃ ghoṣo devānāṃ jayatāmudasthāt
verses.en: Ours be the potent host of mighty Indra, King VAruna, and Maruts, and Adityas. Uplifted is the shout of Gods who conquer, high-minded Gods who cause the worlds to tremble.

verses.sa: उद्धर्षय मघवन्नायुधान्युत्सत्वनां मामकानां मनांसि। उद्वृत्रहन् वाजिनां वाजिनान्युद्रथानां जयतां यन्तु घोषाः॥
verses.tr: uddharṣaya maghavannāyudhānyutsatvanāṃ māmakānāṃ manāṃsi udvṛtrahan vājināṃ vājinānyudrathānāṃ jayatāṃ yantu ghoṣāḥ
verses.en: Bristle thou up, O Bounteous Lord, our weapons: excite the (spirits of my warring heroes. Urge on the strong steeds' might, p Vritra-slayer, and let the din of conquering cars go upward.

verses.sa: अस्माकमिन्द्रः समृतेषु ध्वजेष्वस्माकं या इषवस्ता जयन्तु। अस्माकं वीरा उत्तरे भवन्त्वस्माँ२ उ देवा अवता हवेषु॥
verses.tr: asmākamindraḥ samṛteṣu dhvajeṣvasmākaṃ yā iṣavastā jayantu asmākaṃ vīrā uttare bhavantvasmāṃ2 u devā avatā haveṣu
verses.en: May Indra aid us when our flags are gathered: victorious be the arrows of our army. May our brave men of war prevail in battle. Ye Gods protect us in the shout of onset.

verses.sa: अमीषां चित्तं प्रतिलोभयन्ती गृहाणाङ्गान्यप्वे परेहि। अभि प्रेहि निर्दह हृत्सु शोकैरन्धेनामित्रास्तमसा सचन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: amīṣāṃ cittaṃ pratilobhayantī gṛhāṇāṅgānyapve parehi abhi prehi nirdaha hṛtsu śokairandhenāmitrāstamasā sacantām
verses.en: Bewildering the senses of our foemen, seize thou their bodies' and depart, O Apva. Attack them, set their hearts on fire and burn them: so let our foes abide in utter darkness.

verses.sa: अवसृष्टा परा पत शरव्ये ब्रह्मसंशिते। गच्छामित्रान् प्र पद्यस्व माऽमीषां कं चनोच्छिषः॥
verses.tr: avasṛṣṭā parā pata śaravye brahmasaṃśite gacchāmitrān pra padyasva mā'mīṣāṃ kaṃ canocchiṣaḥ
verses.en: Loosed from the bowstring fly away, O Arrow, sharpened by our prayer. Go to the foemen, strike them home, and let not one of them escape.

verses.sa: प्रेता जयता नर इन्द्रो वः शर्म यच्छतु। उग्रा वः सन्तु बाहवोऽनाधृष्या यथाऽसथ॥
verses.tr: pretā jayatā nara indro vaḥ śarma yacchatu ugrā vaḥ santu bāhavo'nādhṛṣyā yathā'satha
verses.en: Advance, O heroes, win the day. May Indra be your sure defence. ce. Exceeding mighty be your arms, that none may wound or injure you.

verses.sa: असौ या सेना मरुतः परेषामभ्यैति न ओजसा स्पर्धमाना। तां गूहत तमसाऽपव्रतेन यथाऽमी अन्यो अन्यं न जानन्॥
verses.tr: asau yā senā marutaḥ pareṣāmabhyaiti na ojasā spardhamānā tāṃ gūhata tamasā'pavratena yathā'mī anyo anyaṃ na jānan
verses.en: That army of our enemies, O Maruts, that comes against us with its might, centeuding, Meet ye and wrap it in unwelcome darkness so that not one of them may know another.

verses.sa: यत्र बाणाः सम्पतन्ति कुमारा विशिखा इव। तन्न इन्द्रो बृहस्पतिरदितिः शर्म यच्छतु विश्वाहा शर्म यच्छतु॥
verses.tr: yatra bāṇāḥ sampatanti kumārā viśikhā iva tanna indro bṛhaspatiraditiḥ śarma yacchatu viśvāhā śarma yacchatu
verses.en: There where the flights of arrows fall like boys whose locks are yet unshorn, May Indra. may Brihaspati, may Aditi protect us well, protect us well through all our days.

verses.sa: मर्माणि ते वर्मणा छादयामि सोमस्त्वा राजाऽमृतेनानुवस्ताम्। उरोर्वरीयो वरुणस्ते कृणोतु जयन्तं त्वाऽनु देवा मदन्तु॥
verses.tr: marmāṇi te varmaṇā chādayāmi somastvā rājā'mṛtenānuvastām urorvarīyo varuṇaste kṛṇotu jayantaṃ tvā'nu devā madantu
verses.en: Thy vital parts I cover with thine armour: with immortality King Soma clothe thee. Varuna give thee what is more than ample, and in thy triumph may the Gods be joyful.

verses.sa: उदेनमुत्तरां नयाग्ने घृतेनाहुत। रायस्पोषेण सं सृज प्रजया च बहुं कृधि॥
verses.tr: udenamuttarāṃ nayāgne ghṛtenāhuta rāyaspoṣeṇa saṃ sṛja prajayā ca bahuṃ kṛdhi
verses.en: Worshipped with butter, Agni, lead this man to high preeminence. Vouchsafe him growth of riches and multiply him with progenny.

verses.sa: इन्द्रेमं प्रतरां नय सजातानामसद्वशी। समेनं वर्चसा सृज देवानां भागदा असत्॥
verses.tr: indremaṃ pratarāṃ naya sajātānāmasadvaśī samenaṃ varcasā sṛja devānāṃ bhāgadā asat
verses.en: Indra, lead him to eminence: controller of his foes. be hi he. Vouchsafe him lustre: let him give their sacred portions to the Gods.

verses.sa: यस्य कुर्मो गृहे हविस्तमग्ने वर्धया त्वम्। तस्मै देवा अधि ब्रुवन्नयं च ब्रह्मणस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: yasya kurmo gṛhe havistamagne vardhayā tvam tasmai devā adhi bruvannayaṃ ca brahmaṇaspatiḥ
verses.en: The man within whose house we pay oblation, Indra, prosper him. May the Gods bless and comfort him, they and this Brahmanaspati.

verses.sa: उदु त्वा विश्वे देवा अग्ने भरन्तु चित्तिभिः। स नो भव शिवस्त्वं सुप्रतीको विभावसुः॥
verses.tr: udu tvā viśve devā agne bharantu cittibhiḥ sa no bhava śivastvaṃ supratīko vibhāvasuḥ
verses.en: May the All -Gods, O Agni, bear and lift thee upward with their thoughts. Fair to be looked on, rich in light, be thou propitious unto us.

verses.sa: पञ्च दिशो दैवीर्यज्ञमवन्तु देवीरपामतिं दुर्मतिं बाधमानाः। रायस्पोषे यज्ञपतिमाभजन्ती रायस्पोषे अधि यज्ञो अस्थात्॥
verses.tr: pañca diśo daivīryajñamavantu devīrapāmatiṃ durmatiṃ bādhamānāḥ rāyaspoṣe yajñapatimābhajantī rāyaspoṣe adhi yajño asthāt
verses.en: May the Five Regions guard, divine, our worship, God Goddesses chasing lack of thought and hatred. Giving the Sacrificer growth of riches. Let sacrifice be based on growth of riches.

verses.sa: समिद्धे अग्नावधि मामहान उक्थपत्र ईड्यो गृभीतः। तप्तं घर्मं परिगृह्यायजन्तोर्जा यद्यज्ञमयजन्त देवाः॥
verses.tr: samiddhe agnāvadhi māmahāna ukthapatra īḍyo gṛbhītaḥ taptaṃ gharmaṃ parigṛhyāyajantorjā yadyajñamayajanta devāḥ
verses.en: Inspirited above enkindled Agni, adorable, winged with hymns, was it accepted, When the Gods offered sacrifice with viands, circling the heated caldron, paying worship.

verses.sa: दैव्याय धर्त्रे जोष्ट्रे देवश्रीः श्रीमनाः शतपयाः। परिगृह्य देवा यज्ञमायन् देवा देवेभ्यो अध्वर्यन्तो अस्थुः॥
verses.tr: daivyāya dhartre joṣṭre devaśrīḥ śrīmanāḥ śatapayāḥ parigṛhya devā yajñamāyan devā devebhyo adhvaryanto asthuḥ
verses.en: Lord of. a hundred draughts, benign, God-serving—to him divine, establish, er, protector. The Gods approached the sacrifice, encircling. Gods for the Gods stood fain for sacred service.

verses.sa: वीतं हविः शमितं शमिता यजध्यै तुरीयो यज्ञो यत्र हव्यमेति। ततो वाका आशिषो नो जुषन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: vītaṃ haviḥ śamitaṃ śamitā yajadhyai turīyo yajño yatra havyameti tato vākā āśiṣo no juṣantām
verses.en: When the fourth sacrifice reaches the oblation, accepted offering which hath been made ready, fit for the Immolator's sacrificing, Thence bless us prayers and holy recitations!

verses.sa: सूर्यरश्मिर्हरिकेशः पुरस्तात्सविता ज्योतिरुदयाँ२ अजस्रम्। तस्य पूषा प्रसवे याति विद्वान्त्सम्पश्यन्विश्वा भुवनानि गोपाः॥
verses.tr: sūryaraśmirharikeśaḥ purastātsavitā jyotirudayāṃ2 ajasram tasya pūṣā prasave yāti vidvāntsampaśyanviśvā bhuvanāni gopāḥ
verses.en: Savitar, golden-hued, hath lifted eastward, bright with the sunbeams, his eternal lustre. He at whose furtherance wise Pushan marches surveying all existence like a herdsman.

verses.sa: विमान एष दिवो मध्य आस्त आपप्रिवान् रोदसी अन्तरिक्षम्। स विश्वाचीरभि चष्टे घृताचीरन्तरा पूर्वमपरं च केतुम्॥
verses.tr: vimāna eṣa divo madhya āsta āpaprivān rodasī antarikṣam sa viśvācīrabhi caṣṭe ghṛtācīrantarā pūrvamaparaṃ ca ketum
verses.en: He sits, the measurer, in the midst of heaven, filling the two world-halves and air's mid-region, He looks upon the rich far-spreading pastures between the eastern and the western limit.

verses.sa: उक्षा समुद्रो अरुणः सुपर्णः पूर्वस्य योनिं पितुरा विवेश। मध्ये दिवो निहितः पृश्निरश्मा वि चक्रमे रजसस्पात्यन्तौ॥
verses.tr: ukṣā samudro aruṇaḥ suparṇaḥ pūrvasya yoniṃ piturā viveśa madhye divo nihitaḥ pṛśniraśmā vi cakrame rajasaspātyantau
verses.en: Steer, Sea, Red Bird with strong wings, he hath entered the dwelling-place of the Primeval Father. A gay-hued Stone set in the midst of heaven, he hath gone forth and guards the air's two limits.

verses.sa: इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन्त्समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः। रथीतमं रथीनां वाजानां सत्पतिं पतिम्॥
verses.tr: indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhantsamudravyacasaṃ giraḥ rathītamaṃ rathīnāṃ vājānāṃ satpatiṃ patim
verses.en: All sacred songs have glorified Indra expansive as the sea, The best of warriors borne on cars, the Lord, the Very Lord of strength.

verses.sa: देवहूर्यज्ञ आ च वक्षत्सुम्नहूर्यज्ञ आ च वक्षत्। यक्षदग्निर्देवो देवाँ२ आ च वक्षत्॥
verses.tr: devahūryajña ā ca vakṣatsumnahūryajña ā ca vakṣat yakṣadagnirdevo devāṃ2 ā ca vakṣat
verses.en: May God-invoking sacrifice bring the Gods hitherward to us. May bless-invoking sacrifice bring the Gods hitherward to us. May Agni, God, make offering and hither bring the Gods to us.

verses.sa: वाजस्य मा प्रसव उद्ग्राभेणोदग्रभीत्। अधा सपत्नानिन्द्रो मे निग्राभेणाधराँ२ अकः॥
verses.tr: vājasya mā prasava udgrābheṇodagrabhīt adhā sapatnānindro me nigrābheṇādharāṃ2 akaḥ
verses.en: May the abundant growth of wealth with elevation lift me up, And with his subjugating power may Indra keep my foemen down.

verses.sa: उद्ग्राभं च निग्राभं च ब्रह्म देवा अवीवृधन्। अधा सपत्नानिन्द्राग्नी मे विषूचीनान्व्यस्यताम्॥
verses.tr: udgrābhaṃ ca nigrābhaṃ ca brahma devā avīvṛdhan adhā sapatnānindrāgnī me viṣūcīnānvyasyatām
verses.en: Upraising and depression and devotion may the Gods increase. May Indra, too, and Agni drive my foes away to every side.

verses.sa: क्रमध्वमग्निना नाकमुख्यं हस्तेषु बिभ्रतः। दिवस्पृष्ठं स्वर्गत्वा मिश्रा देवेभिराध्वम्॥
verses.tr: kramadhvamagninā nākamukhyaṃ hasteṣu bibhrataḥ divaspṛṣṭhaṃ svargatvā miśrā devebhirādhvam
verses.en: Go ye by Agni to the sky bearing the Ukhya in your hands. Reaching the heights of sky and heaven stay intermingled with the Gods.

verses.sa: प्राचीमनु प्रदिशं प्रेहि विद्वानग्नेरग्ने पुरो अग्निर्भवेह। विश्वा आशा दीद्यानो वि भाह्यूर्जं नो धेहि द्विपदे चतुष्पदे॥
verses.tr: prācīmanu pradiśaṃ prehi vidvānagneragne puro agnirbhaveha viśvā āśā dīdyāno vi bhāhyūrjaṃ no dhehi dvipade catuṣpade
verses.en: Agni, go forward to the eastern region, well-skilled, be here the fire in front of Agni. Illuming all the quarters, shine with splendour: supply with food our quadrupeds and bipeds.

verses.sa: पृथिव्या अहमुदन्तरिक्षमाऽरुहमन्तरिक्षाद्दिवमारुहम्। दिवो नाकस्य पृष्ठात् स्वर्ज्योतिरगामहम्॥
verses.tr: pṛthivyā ahamudantarikṣamā'ruhamantarikṣāddivamāruham divo nākasya pṛṣṭhāt svarjyotiragāmaham
verses.en: From earth to air's mid-region have I mounted, and from mid air ascended up to heaven. From the high pitch of heaven's cope I came into the world of light.

verses.sa: स्वर्यन्तो नापेक्षन्त आ द्यां रोहन्ति रोदसी। यज्ञं ये विश्वतोधारं सुविद्वांसो वितेनिरे॥
verses.tr: svaryanto nāpekṣanta ā dyāṃ rohanti rodasī yajñaṃ ye viśvatodhāraṃ suvidvāṃso vitenire
verses.en: Mounting the sky they look not round: they rise to heaven through both the worlds—Sages who span the sacrifice that pours its stream on every side.

verses.sa: अग्ने प्रेहि प्रथमो देवयतां चक्षुर्देवानामुत मर्त्यानाम्। इयक्षमाणा भृगुभिः सजोषाः स्वर्यन्तु यजमानाः स्वस्ति॥
verses.tr: agne prehi prathamo devayatāṃ cakṣurdevānāmuta martyānām iyakṣamāṇā bhṛgubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ svaryantu yajamānāḥ svasti
verses.en: Foremost of those who seek the Gods come forward, thou who art eye of Gods and men, O Agni. Accordant with the Bhrigus, fain to worship, to heaven in safety go the Sacrifice rs.

verses.sa: नक्तोषासा समनसा विरूपे धापयेते शिशुमेकं समीची। द्यावाक्षामा रुक्मो अन्तर्वि भाति देवा अग्निं धारयन् द्रविणोदाः॥
verses.tr: naktoṣāsā samanasā virūpe dhāpayete śiśumekaṃ samīcī dyāvākṣāmā rukmo antarvi bhāti devā agniṃ dhārayan draviṇodāḥ
verses.en: Night and Dawn, different m in hue, accordant, etc., as iu XII.

verses.sa: अग्ने सहस्राक्ष शतमूर्धञ्छतं ते प्राणाः सहस्रं व्यानाः। त्वं साहस्रस्य राय ईशिषे तस्मै ते विधेम वाजाय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: agne sahasrākṣa śatamūrdhañchataṃ te prāṇāḥ sahasraṃ vyānāḥ tvaṃ sāhasrasya rāya īśiṣe tasmai te vidhema vājāya svāhā
verses.en: O Agui, thousand-eyed and hundred-headed, thy breaths are hundred, thy through-breaths a thousand. Thou art the Lord of thousandfold possessions. To thee, for strength, may we present oblation.

verses.sa: सुपर्णोऽसि गरुत्मान् पृष्ठे पृथिव्याः सीद। भासाऽन्तरिक्षमा पृण ज्योतिषा दिवमुत्तभान तेजसा दिश उद्दृंह॥
verses.tr: suparṇo'si garutmān pṛṣṭhe pṛthivyāḥ sīda bhāsā'ntarikṣamā pṛṇa jyotiṣā divamuttabhāna tejasā diśa uddṛṃha
verses.en: Thou art the Bird of goodly wing: be seated on the ridge of earth. Fill air's mid-region with thy glow, supporting with thy light the sky, confirm the quarters with thy sheen.

verses.sa: आजुह्वानः सुप्रतीकः पुरस्तादग्ने स्वं योनिमा सीद साधुया। अस्मिन्त्सधस्थे अध्युत्तरस्मिन्विश्वे देवा यजमानश्च सीदत॥
verses.tr: ājuhvānaḥ supratīkaḥ purastādagne svaṃ yonimā sīda sādhuyā asmintsadhasthe adhyuttarasminviśve devā yajamānaśca sīdata
verses.en: Receiving offerings, fair of aspect, eastward be duly seated in thy place, O Agni. In this the more exalted habitation be seated All Gods and the Sacrificer.

verses.sa: तां सवितुर्वरेण्यस्य चित्रामाऽहं वृणे सुमतिं विश्वजन्याम्। यामस्य कण्वो अदुहत्प्रपीनां सहस्रधारां पयसा महीं गाम्॥
verses.tr: tāṃ saviturvareṇyasya citrāmā'haṃ vṛṇe sumatiṃ viśvajanyām yāmasya kaṇvo aduhatprapīnāṃ sahasradhārāṃ payasā mahīṃ gām
verses.en: That wondrous all-mankind-embracing favour of Savitar, choice-worthy, I solicit. Even his which Kanva wont to milk, the mighty, the' teeming Cow who yields a thousand milk-streams.

verses.sa: विधेम ते परमे जन्मन्नग्ने विधेम स्तोमैरवरे सधस्थे। यस्माद्योनेरुदारिथा यजे तं प्र त्वे हवींषि जुहुरे समिद्धे॥
verses.tr: vidhema te parame janmannagne vidhema stomairavare sadhasthe yasmādyonerudārithā yaje taṃ pra tve havīṃṣi juhure samiddhe
verses.en: May we adore thee in thy loftiest birth place, Agni! with praise-songs in thy lower station. The place whence those hast issued forth I worship. In thee, well kindled, have they paid oblations.

verses.sa: प्रेद्धो अग्ने दीदिहि पुरो नऽजस्रया सूर्म्या यविष्ठ। त्वां शश्वन्त उप यन्ति वाजाः॥
verses.tr: preddho agne dīdihi puro na'jasrayā sūrmyā yaviṣṭha tvāṃ śaśvanta upa yanti vājāḥ
verses.en: Shine thou before us, Agni. well enkindled, with flame, most youthful God, that never fadeth. Unceasing unto thee come sacred viands.

verses.sa: अग्ने तमद्याश्वं न स्तोमैः क्रतुं न भद्रं हृदिस्पृशम्। ऋध्यामा त ओहैः॥
verses.tr: agne tamadyāśvaṃ na stomaiḥ kratuṃ na bhadraṃ hṛdispṛśam ṛdhyāmā ta ohaiḥ
verses.en: Agni, this day with lauds, etc., as in XV.

verses.sa: चित्तिं जुहोमि मनसा घृतेन यथा देवा इहागमन्वीतिहोत्रा ऋतावृधः। पत्ये विश्वस्य भूमनो जुहोमि विश्वकर्मणे विश्वाहाऽदाभ्यं हविः॥
verses.tr: cittiṃ juhomi manasā ghṛtena yathā devā ihāgamanvītihotrā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ patye viśvasya bhūmano juhomi viśvakarmaṇe viśvāhā'dābhyaṃ haviḥ
verses.en: I dedicate the thought with mind and butter so that the Gods may come who love oblation, strengthening Law, To Visvakarman, Lord of all the earth, I offer up day after day the inviolable sacrifice.

verses.sa: सप्त ते अग्ने समिधः सप्त जिह्वाः सप्त ऋषयः सप्त धाम प्रियाणि। सप्त होत्राः सप्तधा त्वा यजन्ति सप्त योनीरा पृणस्व घृतेन स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: sapta te agne samidhaḥ sapta jihvāḥ sapta ṛṣayaḥ sapta dhāma priyāṇi sapta hotrāḥ saptadhā tvā yajanti sapta yonīrā pṛṇasva ghṛtena svāhā
verses.en: Seven fuel logs hast thou, seven tongues, O Agni, seven Bishis hast thou, seven beloved mansions. Seven-priests in sevenfold manner pay thee worship. Fill full—All-hail to thee!—seven wombs with butter.

verses.sa: शुक्रज्योतिश्च चित्रज्योतिश्च सत्यज्योतिश्च ज्योतिष्माँश्च। शुक्रश्च ऋतपाश्चात्यंहाः॥
verses.tr: śukrajyotiśca citrajyotiśca satyajyotiśca jyotiṣmāṃśca śukraśca ṛtapāścātyaṃhāḥ
verses.en: Purely-Bright, Wonderfully, Bright, Really- Bright, All-Luminous, Bright, Law's-Protector, Safe-from-Ill;

verses.sa: ईदृङ् चान्यादृङ् च सदृङ् च प्रतिसदृङ् च। मितश्च सम्मितश्च सभराः॥
verses.tr: īdṛṅ cānyādṛṅ ca sadṛṅ ca pratisadṛṅ ca mitaśca sammitaśca sabharāḥ
verses.en: Such, Other- Looking, Equal, Similar, Measured, Commensurate, Jointly-Bearing-np.

verses.sa: ऋतश्च सत्यश्च ध्रुवश्च धरुणश्च। धर्ता च विधर्ता च विधारयः॥
verses.tr: ṛtaśca satyaśca dhruvaśca dharuṇaśca dhartā ca vidhartā ca vidhārayaḥ
verses.en: Right, Real, Firm, Strong-to-Support, Bearer, Disposer, Manager.

verses.sa: ऋतजिच्च सत्यजिच्च सेनजिच्च सुषेणश्च। अन्तिमित्रश्च दूरे अमित्रश्च गणः॥
verses.tr: ṛtajicca satyajicca senajicca suṣeṇaśca antimitraśca dūre amitraśca gaṇaḥ
verses.en: Winner-of- Right, Winner-of, Truth, Conquering, Lord-of-Goodly-Host, Whose, Friends-are- Near-at-Hand, Whose-Banded-Enemies-are-Far-Away: Far-Away:

verses.sa: ईदृक्षास एतादृक्षास ऊ षु णः सदृक्षासः प्रतिसदृक्षास एतन। मितासश्च सम्मितासो नो अद्य सभरसो मरुतो यज्ञे अस्मिन्॥
verses.tr: īdṛkṣāsa etādṛkṣāsa ū ṣu ṇaḥ sadṛkṣāsaḥ pratisadṛkṣāsa etana mitāsaśca sammitāso no adya sabharaso maruto yajñe asmin
verses.en: To day in this our sacrifice be present, Such, Looking-Thus, Same, Similar-in-Appearance, Measured, Commensurate, Joint-Bearers, Maruts!

verses.sa: स्वतवाँश्च प्रघासी च सान्तपनश्च गृहमेधी च। क्रीडी च शाकी चोज्जेषी॥
verses.tr: svatavāṃśca praghāsī ca sāntapanaśca gṛhamedhī ca krīḍī ca śākī cojjeṣī
verses.en: Self- Powerful, Voracious-One, Kiu-to-the-Sun, The House, l^older, Play-Lover, Mighty, Conqueror. Fierce, Terrible, The Resonant, The Roaring, Victorious, Assailant, and Dispeller, All-Hail!

verses.sa: इन्द्रं दैवीर्विशो मरुतोऽनुवर्त्मानोऽभवन्यथेन्द्रं दैवीर्विशो मरुतोऽनुवर्त्मानोऽभवन्। एवमिमं यजमानं दैवीश्च विशो मानुषीश्चानुवर्त्मानो भवन्तु॥
verses.tr: indraṃ daivīrviśo maruto'nuvartmāno'bhavanyathendraṃ daivīrviśo maruto'nuvartmāno'bhavan evamimaṃ yajamānaṃ daivīśca viśo mānuṣīścānuvartmāno bhavantu
verses.en: The Maruts, clans divine, became the followers of Indra; as The Maruts, clans divine, became the followers of Indra, so May clans divine and human be the Sacrificer's followers.

verses.sa: इमं स्तनमूर्जस्वन्तं धयापां प्रपीनमग्ने सरिरस्य मध्ये। उत्सं जुषस्व मधुमन्तमर्वन्त्समुद्रियं सदनमा विशस्व॥
verses.tr: imaṃ stanamūrjasvantaṃ dhayāpāṃ prapīnamagne sarirasya madhye utsaṃ juṣasva madhumantamarvantsamudriyaṃ sadanamā viśasva
verses.en: Drink in the middle of the flood, O Agni, this breast stored full of sap, teeming with water. Welcome this fountain redolent of sweetness. O Courser, enter those thy watery dwelling.

verses.sa: घृतं मिमिक्षे घृतमस्य योनिर्घृते श्रितो घृतम्वस्य धाम। अनुष्वधमा वह मादयस्व स्वाहाकृतं वृषभ वक्षि हव्यम्॥
verses.tr: ghṛtaṃ mimikṣe ghṛtamasya yonirghṛte śrito ghṛtamvasya dhāma anuṣvadhamā vaha mādayasva svāhākṛtaṃ vṛṣabha vakṣi havyam
verses.en: Oil hath been mixed: oil is his habitation. In oil he rests: oil is his proper province. Come as thy wont is. O thou Steer, rejoice thee. Bear off the oblation duly consecrated.

verses.sa: समुद्रादूर्मिर्मधुमाँ२ उदारदुपांशुना सममृतत्वमानट्। घृतस्य नाम गुह्यं यदस्ति जिह्वा देवानाममृतस्य नाभिः॥
verses.tr: samudrādūrmirmadhumāṃ2 udāradupāṃśunā samamṛtatvamānaṭ ghṛtasya nāma guhyaṃ yadasti jihvā devānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ
verses.en: Forth from the ocean sprang the wave of sweetness: together with the stalk it turned to Amrit, That which is holy oil's mysterious title: but the Gods' tongue is truly Amrit's centre.

verses.sa: वयं नाम प्र ब्रवामा घृतस्यास्मिन् यज्ञे धारयामा नमोभिः। उप ब्रह्मा शृणवच्छस्यमानं चतुःशृङ्गोऽवमीद्गौर एतत्॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ nāma pra bravāmā ghṛtasyāsmin yajñe dhārayāmā namobhiḥ upa brahmā śṛṇavacchasyamānaṃ catuḥśṛṅgo'vamīdgaura etat
verses.en: Let us Declare aloud the name of Ghrita, and at this sacrifice held it up with homage. So let the Brahman hear the praise we utter. This hath the four-horned Buffalo emitted.

verses.sa: चत्वारि शृङ्गा त्रयो अस्य पादा द्वे शीर्षे सप्त हस्तासो अस्य। त्रिधा बद्धो वृषभो रोरवीति महो देवो मर्त्याँ२ आ विवेश॥
verses.tr: catvāri śṛṅgā trayo asya pādā dve śīrṣe sapta hastāso asya tridhā baddho vṛṣabho roravīti maho devo martyāṃ2 ā viveśa
verses.en: Four are his horns, three are the feet that bear him: his 'heads are two, his hands <are seven in number. Bound with a' triple bond the Bull roars loudly: the mighty God hath entered into mortals.

verses.sa: त्रिधा हितं पणिभिर्गुह्यमानं गवि देवासो घृतमन्वविन्दन्। इन्द्र एकं सूर्य एकं जजान वेनादेकं स्वधया निष्टतक्षुः॥
verses.tr: tridhā hitaṃ paṇibhirguhyamānaṃ gavi devāso ghṛtamanvavindan indra ekaṃ sūrya ekaṃ jajāna venādekaṃ svadhayā niṣṭatakṣuḥ
verses.en: That oil in triple shape the Gods discovered laid down within the Cow, concealed' d by Panis. Indra produced one shape, SArya another: by their own power they formed the third from Vena.

verses.sa: एता अर्षन्ति हृद्यात्समुद्राच्छतव्रजा रिपुणा नावचक्षे। घृतस्य धारा अभि चाकशीमि हिरण्ययो वेतसो मध्य आसाम्॥
verses.tr: etā arṣanti hṛdyātsamudrācchatavrajā ripuṇā nāvacakṣe ghṛtasya dhārā abhi cākaśīmi hiraṇyayo vetaso madhya āsām
verses.en: From inmost reservoir in countless channels flow down these rivers which the foe beholds not. I look upon the streams of oil descending, and lo! I the Golden Reed is there among them.

verses.sa: सम्यक् स्रवन्ति सरितो न धेना अन्तर्हृदा मनसा पूयमानाः। एते अर्षन्त्यूर्मयो घृतस्य मृगा इव क्षिपणोरीषमाणाः॥
verses.tr: samyak sravanti sarito na dhenā antarhṛdā manasā pūyamānāḥ ete arṣantyūrmayo ghṛtasya mṛgā iva kṣipaṇorīṣamāṇāḥ
verses.en: Like rivers our libations flow together, cleansing them themselves in inmost heart and spirit. The streams of holy oil pour swiftly downward like the wild beasts that fly before the bowman.

verses.sa: सिन्धोरिव प्राध्वने शूघनासो वातप्रमियः पतयन्ति यह्वाः। घृतस्य धारा अरुषो न वाजी काष्ठा भिन्दन्नूर्मिभिः पिन्वमानः॥
verses.tr: sindhoriva prādhvane śūghanāso vātapramiyaḥ patayanti yahvāḥ ghṛtasya dhārā aruṣo na vājī kāṣṭhā bhindannūrmibhiḥ pinvamānaḥ
verses.en: As rushing down the rapids of a river, flow swifter than the wind the vigorous currents, 'The streams of oil in swelling fluctuation like a red courser bursting through the fences.

verses.sa: अभि प्रवन्त समनेव योषाः कल्याण्यः स्मयमानासो अग्निम्। घृतस्य धाराः समिधो नसन्त ता जुषाणो हर्यति जातवेदाः॥
verses.tr: abhi pravanta samaneva yoṣāḥ kalyāṇyaḥ smayamānāso agnim ghṛtasya dhārāḥ samidho nasanta tā juṣāṇo haryati jātavedāḥ
verses.en: Like women at a gathering fair to look on and gently smiling, they incline to Agni. The streams of holy oil attain the fuel, and Jatavedas joyfully receives them.

verses.sa: कन्या इव वहतुमेतवा उ अञ्ज्यञ्जाना अभि चाकशीमि। यत्र सोमः सूयते यत्र यज्ञो घृतस्य धारा अभि तत्पवन्ते॥
verses.tr: kanyā iva vahatumetavā u añjyañjānā abhi cākaśīmi yatra somaḥ sūyate yatra yajño ghṛtasya dhārā abhi tatpavante
verses.en: As maidens deck themselves with gay adornment to join the bridal feast, I now behold them. Where Soma flows and sacrifice is ready, thither the streams of holy oil are running. I

verses.sa: अभ्यर्षत सुष्टुतिं गव्यमाजिमस्मासु भद्रा द्रविणानि धत्त। इमं यज्ञं नयत देवता नो घृतस्य धारा मधुमत्पवन्ते॥
verses.tr: abhyarṣata suṣṭutiṃ gavyamājimasmāsu bhadrā draviṇāni dhatta imaṃ yajñaṃ nayata devatā no ghṛtasya dhārā madhumatpavante
verses.en: Send to our eulogy a herd of cattle: bestow upon us excellent possessions. Bear to the Gods the sacrifice we w offer: the streams of oil flow pure and full of sweetness.

verses.sa: धामं ते विश्वं भुवनमधि श्रितमन्तः समुद्रे हृद्यन्तरायुषि। अपामनीके समिथे य आभृतस्तमश्याम मधुमन्तं त ऊर्मिम्॥
verses.tr: dhāmaṃ te viśvaṃ bhuvanamadhi śritamantaḥ samudre hṛdyantarāyuṣi apāmanīke samithe ya ābhṛtastamaśyāma madhumantaṃ ta ūrmim
verses.en: The universe depends upon thy power and might within the sea, within the heart, within all life. May we attain that sweetly-flavoured wave of thine, brought, at this gathering, o'er the surface of the floods.
